notebooks.limitations: Synthetic fluid, compact route, explicit staggered coupling, feed-matched separator gas draw, first-order recycle flow, generated teaching compressor map, and calculated surge entry are not a field control design. Real use requires governed PVT and route data, mesh and timestep convergence, strong-coupling review, valve and header volumes, vendor maps and transient limits, recycle piping and cooler, trip logic, uncertainty, and independent verification.
notebooks.summary: Updated the detailed current-master NeqSim tutorial to couple the corrected native TwoFluidPipe outlet process stream directly into the dynamic topside model while retaining phase-resolved conservative audits. The notebook validates the merged fixes for issues #2813 and #2814, closes the slug ledger after exit, identifies and corrects a notebook PID-tuning failure against current master, conditions the sharp steady-to-dynamic handover, and passes all 26 named gates.
